name: Sculpfun S9
tagline: Sculpfun's proven budget line — still popular for value-focused makers
tldr: Before S30 Ultra, the S9 was Sculpfun's workhorse. Still sold and widely documented in community guides. Lower power than current flagships but excellent value for engraving-focused hobbyists who do not need 20W cutting.
mainObjective: Budget Sculpfun for reliable wood engraving before upgrading to S30 class

engraveExample.description: Filled photo or logo on birch plywood

cutExample.description: Simple square cut-out from 3 mm basswood

cons: Slower than S30 Ultra on same jobs
New buyers often better served by S30 Ultra sales
Air assist recommended for clean cuts
beginnerNotes: Buy S9 only on significant discount vs S30 Ultra. The ~$100–150 difference usually buys meaningfully faster jobs and better cutting.
proTips: S9 community mods (air assist, extended feet) are well documented — search Sculpfun Facebook groups before your first big project.
primaryUse: Budget Sculpfun open-frame for wood/leather engraving and light thin-wood cutting.
